0.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_KJARTAN_000_000
0.description: What brings you to Twine, if you don't mind me asking?

1.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_KJARTAN_000_010
1.description: Though we no longer have that wretched Light constantly glaring down upon us, precious little else has changed around here. Most of us are still living hand-to-mouth no matter how hard we work.

2.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_KJARTAN_000_020
2.description: So much for the return of the night sky! It was good while it lasted, I suppose. At any rate, it's all the same when you're breaking rocks in some mine.

3.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_KJARTAN_000_030
3.description: Is the Light gone for good this time? I bloody well hope so.

6.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_A1_000_002
6.description: What kind of place is this?

8.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_KJARTAN_000_100
8.description: Like most people around here, I'm a miner.

9.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_KJARTAN_000_101
9.description: It's all I know, and to be perfectly honest, there isn't much else <hex:021A020203>to<hex:021A020103> know in Amh Araeng.

10.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_KJARTAN_000_200
10.description: Not many people are aware of this─even those who live here─but Twine was built through the combined efforts of the Ronso and Mystel. The name of this town comes from the idea of their tails being entwined together.

11.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_KJARTAN_000_201
11.description: You don't see much cooperation between them these days, though. Most of the Mystel moved to Eulmore years ago and there are only one or two left now.

12.name: TEXT_REGNOR4TWINE_00598_KJARTAN_000_202
12.description: We Ronso, on the other hand, don't give up so easily. As long as there is work to be done, we'll be here.
